info.title: Agent API
info.description: The conservation.tv agent API, served by the agent itself.

get.description: Whether the agent is up and serving requests.

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

get.description: Each runtime's live status, and whether it has accepted its latest spec. Live, never stored: after a restart it is rebuilt from the runtimes. From this version, with `cameras`, the cameras it controls and who holds each; `chat`, the chat it listens to for commands; and `peers`, how many devices it serves.

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

get.summary: Read the agent's currently defined spec
get.description: From this version, with `probes`: the cameras it asks whether they are there.

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

get.summary: List the cameras the agent controls
get.description: Each camera the studio gave the agent that is `enabled`, by its ID there, with its `capabilities`: the `moves` it takes, how far it pans and tilts in degrees, whether it zooms and focuses, the `options` it has with the values each takes, and the `actions` it runs. A camera that cannot move lists no moves. `capabilities` is null while the camera has not answered.

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

get.description: Asked of the camera now: its `position` on each axis it has (`pan` and `tilt` in degrees, `zoom` and `focus` as fractions of its range), what its `options` are set to, and its `holder`, the peer at its controls and until when unless they go on, or null.

404.description: The agent controls no such camera: it is not one of its cameras, or not enabled

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

502.description: The camera did not answer, or refused

post.description: Carries out one `command` its grant admits. The grant, in the `Camera-Grant` header, is a JWT the studio API signed with this agent's identity, for this agent, to the peer sending it: `grant_refused` (403) without one, or when it is another device's, another camera's, expired, admits only a different command, or admits one command and has been used. A person's grant admits any command while it lasts, and takes the camera for a few seconds after each: `camera_held` (409) turns away automation, such as a chat command, while someone else holds it. `drive` keeps the camera moving only while it is repeated: the agent stops a camera that isn't driven again within a second or so. `unsupported_command` (422) for a move the camera's capabilities don't list, and `camera_failed` (502) when the camera doesn't answer or refuses.

403.description: No grant was presented, or it does not admit this command to this camera from this peer

404.description: The agent controls no such camera: it is not one of its cameras, or not enabled

409.description: Someone else is at the camera's controls

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

502.description: The camera did not answer, or refused

command.description: A command, by `kind`: `moveTo` a position, `moveBy` an offset, `moveToPoint` or `moveToRegion` of the picture, `drive` at a velocity on each axis (repeated while it should keep moving), `stop`, `configure` one of its options, or `run` one of its actions.

get.description: A `text/event-stream` of the camera’s state, as `cameras.state.get` gives it: a `state` event at once, and another each time its position, its options or its holder changes, with a `ping` when nothing has for a while. The stream ends after ten minutes, or when the camera is no longer controlled here: ask again to keep following.
